webui.note: The first screen: Brotli-11, window 24, of _framework/ less the lazy set, on a publish from a clean tree. Budget 2026-10-28 (ADR 0205); measured 2026-11-20 with the explorer-only components moved to the explorer (ADR 0252 point 7), the explorer, Varve.Sparql and Varve.Sparql.Results lazy (ADR 0205, amended 2026-11-19). Raising it is an amendment to ADR 0205.

webui-explorer.note: The explorer's lazy set, the assemblies the boot manifest marks lazyAssembly, which must be exactly these; budget from the Query screen's measurement of 2026-11-19 plus 5%, rounded up to 10 kB: 91,087 B to 100,000 B (ADR 0205, amended 2026-11-19, point 4; the maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-20); measured 96,883 B on 2026-11-20 with the explorer-only components moved (point 5). Raising the budget or changing the set is an amendment to ADR 0205.
